instruction: Send a reminder on Venmo for all my payment requests to my coworkers which have not been approved or denied for 40 or more days.
notes: Two-app task (phone for the coworker contact list, venmo for the sent payment requests). Knowledge flow: show_profile gives the phone number (phone username) and email (venmo username); show_account_passwords gives both passwords; phone.search_contacts with query/relationship 'coworkers' reveals who the coworkers are (coworkers-found); phone.get_current_date_and_time grounds the 40-day cutoff (current-date-known); venmo.show_sent_payment_requests with status=pending lists the candidate requests (requests-listed). The remind action is structurally restricted to requests addressed to a coworker that are pending and at least 40 days old, so non-qualifying requests (a recent one to a coworker, an old one to a non-coworker, included as distractors) can never be reminded. Since the real database is unknown, the problem instantiates two representative qualifying requests; they are declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can require every goal reminder, per the convention. At runtime the agent paginates both list calls and reminds every request matching the filter (all qualifying ones), then calls complete_task without an answer.
